artifact_format_decision.canonical_document: UTF-8 Markdown; a small portable subset, no custom component syntax or embedded presentation state.
artifact_format_decision.format_scope: Markdown is the default for prose documents. Code, data, and standalone interactive outputs retain appropriate native file formats.
artifact_format_decision.graphics: Separate image files referenced by relative Markdown paths. Version image assets together with document revisions.
artifact_format_decision.chat_visuals: Interactive charts and explanations rendered in chat. Explicitly capture an image to include in Markdown.
artifact_format_decision.metadata: Separate JSON comments and revision metadata. Keep older Markdown and assets as snapshots or Git blobs. No formal source-to-draft mappings.
artifact_format_decision.comment_anchors: A base revision plus quoted passage and surrounding context. If a match is ambiguous after edits, flag it for review instead of silently moving it.
source_flow: Read a source in place when the request is read-only.
On an editing request, bring text into a Markdown draft in the task folder.
Edit and discuss Markdown. The agent can retain useful source context privately.
Save files and metadata in the task folder; share that folder with native access controls.
artifact_format_decision.product_boundary: Light draft review: plain editing, agent-proposed changes, comments, and snapshots. No page layout, rich word processing, or live coediting infrastructure.

task_folder_decision.unit: One new working folder per task; sharing covers files, assets, comments, revision history, and explicitly shared task notes.
task_folder_decision.default: Cloud OneDrive interface backed by an institution-managed SharePoint library, not dependent on a student account lifetime.
task_folder_decision.management: Backend provisions and manages folders under administrator policy. File-edit rights and authority to manage native sharing are separate. A write-capable app is not automatically an institution-owned folder.
task_folder_decision.sharing_default: Task creator plus institution management; selected authenticated people/groups get view or edit. No public link by default. Existing upstream inherited access must be displayed, not hidden.
task_folder_decision.github: Task folder and working branch in school-owned private repository. Use a separate repository for independent sharing; an existing repository shares its access across every task folder. Review a pull request for repository publication.
task_folder_decision.local: Secondary advanced location; encourage cloud. GitHub integration can make a repository copy. No local-folder sharing service.
task_folder_decision.personal_context: Private conversations, agent context, and external source selections remain outside the shared folder by default. Shared notes are explicit files. Institution policy determines administrator access to sessions.
task_folder_decision.collaboration_boundary: Files, comments, proposed changes, and revisions; no live Word editor, presence system, or document-suite expansion.

concurrent_work.status: Interaction demonstrated locally with scripted concurrent activity and simple guarded file updates. Production isolation and integration remain unimplemented.
concurrent_work.principle: People and agents work in parallel; changes to each existing shared file are coordinated through the harness.
concurrent_work.independent_work: Run research, calculations, and draft preparation separately. New outputs receive distinct paths; private scratch stays outside the shared working files.
concurrent_work.existing_files: Agents can prepare changes to the same file independently. The harness applies compatible changes to the current shared version in order, without a visible busy-file workflow.
concurrent_work.human_edits: Small plain Markdown edits remain secondary. The harness must preserve a person’s current text when an agent result arrives; review an ordinary suggested revision if the content changed.
concurrent_work.stale_changes: Retain the request and base revision. Re-evaluate against current content instead of replaying an old whole-file replacement. Preserve others’ contributions and flag ambiguous or contradictory changes as proposals.
concurrent_work.metadata: The coordinator records comments and revisions as separate events; agents do not independently replace one shared comments/history JSON file.
concurrent_work.ux: Default to shared Agent work: person, agent task, tool progress, finished output, and a brief decision when needed. Each person has a separate conversation. Internal drafts, base revisions, locks, and merging are not ordinary product UI.
concurrent_work.external_edits: OneDrive clients, GitHub pushes, and local tools can bypass app coordination. Provider version checks, revision preservation, and recovery are required; complete conflict prevention is not promised for unrestricted external writes.
concurrent_work.scope: Parallel agent work, output inspection, and contribution history. No simultaneous collaborative document editing surface.
concurrent_work.implementation_validation_needed: Verify the chosen provider write API’s check-at-commit behavior, not just a read-then-write or upload-session-start version check.
concurrent_work.t3_refinement: One writer to the published version does not limit parallel edits to private versions. Isolate longer overlapping work; coordinate publication and integration afterward. Do not imply T3 itself supplies automatic conflict-free merging.

precedent_reviews.method: Read public repository source in a temporary shallow checkout. No application execution or dependency installation.

findings.finding: Thread launch can create a branch and separate worktree before starting the agent. Independent work can change the same filenames without sharing one working copy.
Batch create_threads copies the parent project, branch, and worktree path. Isolation is an explicit option, not a universal guarantee for parallel agents.
Whole-checkout file restoration requires an isolated worktree. Other threads, provider sessions, and overlapping checkout paths are checked to prevent reverting another thread’s work.
Checkpoint operations are serialized by workspace path. This coordinates snapshot operations; it is not a general lock around all provider filesystem writes.

precedent_reviews.limits: No general per-file agent write lock or automatic merge coordinator was found in the inspected launch, orchestration instructions, shared-checkout creation, and checkpoint paths. Worktree isolation moves integration to a later step; it does not eliminate overlapping changes or incompatible intentions.
precedent_reviews.product_implication: Retain an ordered publication path for the current shared folder. Allow agents to prepare and edit independent versions in parallel. Use isolated drafts for lengthy or alternative work; integrate changes with a known base revision and preserve proposals on overlap. GitHub can use native branches/worktrees; OneDrive would require harness-managed private working copies and publication logic.
precedent_reviews.scope_boundary: No branch management required in the ordinary student UX. Small activity labels and change summaries; no simultaneous collaborative text editor.
